biography:
I am a public policy practitioner with over eight years of experience in economic development, financial inclusion, and gender-responsive policy design in Pakistan. I have been associated with diverse public sector organizations such as the central bank of Pakistan, Punjab Local Government & Community Development Department, & the Prime Minister's Office Board of Investment.
I completed a Master’s degree in Public Affairs from Indiana University Bloomington as a Fulbright Program scholar, with a concentration in Policy Analysis and International Development. I write on culture and socio-economic issues.
